v2 proposed on the existing feature/chat branch: project-chat vocabulary, live project-channel grants, code and attachment rendering, project chat entry point, author population and a channel member panel. Branch recorded as feature/chat (base main) because that branch already holds the chat code.
Gate 1 approved. Specification (7 user stories, 24 acceptance criteria, 24 functional and 13 non-functional requirements) and the 37-row traceability matrix accepted.
Gate 2 approved. Plan and 32 tasks across P20-P27 accepted; every requirement maps to a plan section and at least one task, and all 24 acceptance criteria are linked.

Implementation complete on feature/chat: all 32 tasks across P20-P27 built. Server and client typecheck, client lint and build pass; governance validators pass; secret scan clean. sdrive verify reports fail with 44 missing / 217 extra, every missing item attributable to the CON-614 scanner gaps (no client/ scan, workspace-root dependency read, no Mongoose entity detection, absolute-vs-relative endpoint paths) and confirmed present in the repository.

spec_updated (/sdrive:update-propose, Gate 1 draft): amendment to v2 from a maintainer walkthrough after v2 shipped. Added US-043..US-048, AC-100..AC-116, FR-096..FR-105, NFR-042..NFR-046, EC-043..EC-049 and RISK-013..RISK-016 to spec.md and spec.json, plus 15 rows in traceability.json (status in_progress; the task column is provisional until Gate 2). The amendment supersedes the sidebar clause of AC-076 and narrows AC-077: one Project chat navigation item replaces the team-chat sidebar item and links to /{workspaceSlug}/chat, so the chat root lists every channel and direct message and no longer redirects to a default channel. It also records seven defects that no criterion covered: a bounded chat height with independent scroll containers and a header that stays put; a token-based hover surface on the code card's Copy and Download controls; the caller's project membership passed to decideChannelAccess in downloadAttachment; unread reconciliation and live grant/rename handling in the sidebar; opening a conversation the client has not listed; recency ordering on first paint; and a live thread update. Existing IDs, text and rows are untouched, AC-076/AC-077 keep their wording, and the amendment note states which behaviour wins. The specification gate is reset to pending because new requirements invalidate the previous approval, and the implementation gate returns to in_progress because T28.x-T32.x are unbuilt; plan.md, tasks.md, plan.json and tasks.json are deliberately untouched until Gate 1 is approved. Validator: real-time-chat/v2 spec.json, plan.json, tasks.json and traceability.json are valid, and this reset also clears the two pre-existing workflow-state schema errors (v2 currentStep test, implementation complete). No external research was available: the ux-ui-library, Stackwise and Context7 MCP servers are unreachable here, so the amendment cites only in-repository sources (DESIGN.md, perfect-ui-rules.md, the constitution, client/src/index.css and the chat module).

Gate 1 approved by the user in session on 2026-10-28, conditioned on restating AC-114 as ONE merged, recency-ordered conversation list instead of two labelled segments. Restated: AC-114 and FR-105 now require a single run of rows with no per-kind headings, and the amendment note records that this amends AC-056 and AC-065 for that view while keeping the shared row rendering those criteria established. Gate 2 was then approved on 2026-10-28: plan section 11 and phases P28-P32 (19 tasks, T28.1-T32.5) accepted, with every new requirement linked to at least one acceptance criterion and at least one task.

history.event: Specification gate re-approved by the user after the amendment (audit event gate_approved for real-time-chat v2 specification, hash-chained at 885fb90d2cd5aab9fbfd42905a24bf9ea539164f7a3ce4223cb98ef8f12407d5). The specification and planning gates are approved and the current step moves to implementation; the implementation gate stays in_progress because phases P28-P32 (T28.1-T32.5) are not built yet.

Implementation complete on feature/chat (P28-P32, 19 tasks, T28.1-T32.5). Added the Project chat navigation item and the conversation root that no longer redirects, a viewport-bounded chat frame with independent list and message scroll owners and a header outside the message scroll, the token-based hover layer on the code card, project membership passed to decideChannelAccess in downloadAttachment, unread reconciliation from the local read state with a one-way notice to the sidebar, one merged recency-ordered conversation list built from ConversationRow plus mergeConversations, and a chat:thread event carrying the authoritative post-increment reply count that the client patches onto the parent row. Gates run with the local toolchain after reinstalling node_modules from the lockfile: client tsc -b and tsc -p tsconfig.test.json exit 0, eslint exit 0, vite build exit 0 (31.6 s), server tsc --noEmit exit 0, governance validator all files valid. sdrive verify reports fail with matched 16 / missing 72 / renamed 0 / extra 216; every missing item is a client path (the scanner scans server and api only), a Mongoose entity or field, a workspace-declared dependency, or an absolute-vs-relative route path, which are the four documented CON-614 gaps, and each one exists in the repository. Not performed: the CON-703 browser pass, which needs a running MongoDB, the dev server and a browser. Tests remain for /sdrive:test; chatMessageLifecycle.test.ts still asserts the previous updateOne increment and SidebarChannels.test.tsx still expects the removed team/general rows, so both need updating there.

history.summary: Amendment 2 (/sdrive:update-propose, second walkthrough): appended US-049..US-054, AC-117..AC-123 (7 acceptance criteria), FR-106..FR-111 (6 functional), NFR-047..NFR-048 (2 non-functional), EC-050..EC-054 (5 edge cases) and RISK-018..RISK-019 (2 risks) to spec.md and spec.json, plus 8 rows in traceability.json (in_progress, plan section 12, task column provisional until Gate 2). It narrows section 9's sidebar change: the chat group keeps a General channel row again and stops listing direct messages, so the sidebar holds Project chat plus General while direct messages live only in the conversation list; General stays readable by every workspace member with chat:read. It also pins six defects found in the build: the empty pane does not centre its block or narrow its description; the image overlay uses bg-slate-900, which the dark theme remaps to a light inverse surface instead of a dark scrim; opening a conversation never clears the ConversationCard unread flag, so the list badge survives; the sender never receives their own chat:message or chat:thread, so their card does not rise and their reply count stays stale. Existing IDs, text and rows are untouched. The specification gate is reset to pending for re-approval and the implementation gate returns to in_progress because P33-P36 are unbuilt; plan.md, tasks.md, plan.json and tasks.json are unchanged until Gate 1 is approved.

onboarding.notes: Onboarding re-run on an already-adopted workspace. The scan found 16 existing specs, 5 skills, a constitution (v1.0.2, preserved unchanged) and 66 governance documents. workflow-state.json had been reset to {"features": []}, so the feature registry was rebuilt from each spec's own status line; no feature history was invented. No external spec system (OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, Agent OS, BMAD) was present, so no migration ran. Prettier configuration is absent by design (CON-209), not a gap. real-time-chat remains backlog pending Gate 1.
